visual.general_description: CONSORT-style flow diagram of screening and enrollment counts for the VR GMI case series.
visual.detailed_description: Single whole-figure flow diagram without panel letters showing 52 assessed, 46 excluded (41 not meeting criteria, 5 declined), 6 enrolled, 2 discharged or transferred within 3 days and 4 completing all three stages, with a separate box describing procedural amendments.

panels.general_description: CONSORT-style flow diagram of screening, exclusion, enrollment and completion counts.
panels.detailed_description: White-background flow diagram of rounded boxes joined by thick black lines with arrowheads. The top-left box reads Assessed for eligibility (n = 52) with bullets Operating room slates (n = 32), Pre-anesthetic clinic (n = 11) and Charge nurse referrals (n = 9) followed by an asterisk. A box at top right headed with an asterisk and the words Procedural Amendments lists two bullets: eligibility window expanded from 5 days or less to 2 months or less post-LLA, and added charge nurse referrals as a new recruitment pathway; it has no connecting arrow. A large right-hand box reads Excluded (n = 46) with Not meeting inclusion criteria (n = 41) and eight bullets (Discharged/transferred ≤3 days 17, Major bilateral LLA 8, Cognitive impairment 5, Sensory/motor impairment 2, LLA >2 months ago 2, Critical illness/intubation 3, Behavioural concerns 1, No LLA performed 3) and Declined (felt overwhelmed) (n = 5). A lower-left box reads Enrolled and received intervention (n = 6) with Recruited under original protocol (n = 3) and Recruited after procedural amendments (n = 3) followed by an asterisk. A small right-hand box reads Discharged/transferred ≤3 days (n = 2). The bottom box reads Completed intervention (i.e., all three stages of VR GMI program) (n = 4). There are no photographs, faces, patient names or identifiers.

Column headings P1, P2, P3 and P5 each carry Pre and Post sub-columns. Rows are grouped under Session 1 to Session 5, each with PLP, RLP and Nausea. Session 1 prints PLP 0/0, 0/0, 2/1, 4/4; RLP 6/6, 6/6, 4/4, 10/10; Nausea 0 throughout. Session 2 prints NA for P1; PLP P2 0/0, P3 0/0, P5 10/6*; RLP P2 7/7, P3 3/3, P5 6/2*; Nausea P2 1/1, P3 0/0, P5 0/0. Session 3 prints PLP P2 0/0, P3 0/0, P5 3/3; RLP 7/7, 3/3, 5/5; Nausea 0. Session 4 prints NA for P1 and P3; PLP P2 3/3, P5 7/5; RLP P2 8/8, P5 7/4*; Nausea 0. Session 5 prints NA for P1 and P3; PLP P2 0/7*, P5 6/6; RLP P2 5/7, P5 2/2; Nausea 0. Pale blue shading sits behind P5 session 2 PLP (10 and 6*), P5 session 2 RLP (6 and 2*) and P5 session 4 RLP (7 and 4*); pale orange shading sits behind P2 session 5 PLP (0 and 7*). Footnotes explain pre and post scores, asterisks and shading, NA, and the abbreviations. There is no photograph, face or identifier.
